facts.statement: Instrument INS-12 has an in-date label but laboratory report received 2026-10-05 establishes it is outside acceptable tolerance for specified commissioning measurements. Prior reports TEST-A and TEST-B used INS-12; significance needs competent review. No universal retest interval is supplied.
